struttura.title: The Structure
struttura.subtitle: A private apartment of 50 m² in the heart of the historic center
struttura.description: A Due Passi Da is not a traditional B&B, but a private apartment located on the first floor of a historic building in the center of Corato. Perfect for families and couples who want an authentic experience in Puglia. The apartment consists of 2 bedrooms and can accommodate up to 4-5 guests, making it ideal for families with children or groups of friends.
struttura.accessibilityNotice: Upper floors are accessible only by stairs. The property does not have an elevator.

items.description: UNESCO heritage, the enigmatic octagonal castle of Frederick II. A medieval masterpiece.

items.name: Alberobello

items.name: Polignano a Mare

items.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
items.answer: Check-in is flexible upon agreement. Check-out is by 11:00 AM. We recommend communicating your arrival time in advance.

items.question: Is breakfast included?
items.answer: Yes, breakfast is included in the rate. You will find basic items for a continental breakfast in the equipped kitchen.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: Yes, private parking is available upon reservation at a cost of €20 per day.

items.question: Is there an elevator?
items.answer: No, upper floors are accessible only by stairs. The property does not have an elevator.

items.question: Is Wi-Fi free?
items.answer: Yes, high-speed Wi-Fi (135 Mbps) is free and available throughout the property.

items.question: Are pets allowed?
items.answer: Please contact us to discuss the possibility of hosting pets.

items.question: How do I reach the property from the station/airport?
items.answer: Corato FS station is 700 meters away (10 minutes on foot). From Bari airport (42 km) we offer a shuttle service on request.

items.question: How does the quote request work?
items.answer: Fill in the form in the Quote section or contact us via email/WhatsApp. We will respond within 24 hours with availability and prices.

items.question: Can I receive an invoice?
items.answer: Yes, we issue a regular invoice on request. Please provide your tax details at the time of booking.

items.question: Is the property suitable for families?
items.answer: Absolutely! We have high chairs, strollers available and family rooms. The private apartment is perfect for families.
